descriptions.description: Lectotype (Sokoloff in Turland & Jarvis in Taxon 46: 463. 1997): [icon] " Anthyllis herbacea, floliis pinnatis inaequalibus, pedunculis axillaribus folio longioribus, capitulis nudis " in Gerard, Fl. Gallo-Provincialis: 490, t. 18. 1761.
